name: Taifoon — watch the chain for completed jobs

parameters.content:
## Taifoon: watch the chain for completed jobs
**For:** teams that report on agent work and want each completed job checked against the chain, not taken on trust.
**Why:** the Taifoon Trigger starts on every job change; Proof → Verify Hire Claim asks the chain to confirm the settlement and its payee, and the verdict (REAL · FABRICATED · UNVERIFIED) is written beside the job.

**Set up**
1. Get a free key: the node's **Account → Register Free Key**, template 11, or `curl -s -X POST https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/register -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'` (the key is shown once).
2. Add a **Taifoon Relayer API** credential with the key (Credentials → New) and select it on the Taifoon nodes that ask for one. Watching needs no key; the check runs on the key's own budget.
3. Activate the workflow, or connect **Report** to your sheet or chat.

**Test it:** open the trigger and click **Fetch Test Event**: it reads the current window without moving the cursor. **Report** shows each job with its verdict.

**Limits:** the trigger polls, at least once per change: a job that is funded, submitted and completed is emitted three times. Without a key the check counts against the visitor budget of the calling address.

**Needs the community node** `n8n-nodes-taifoon` (tested with 2.1.0): self-hosted n8n → Settings → Community nodes → Install → `n8n-nodes-taifoon`. https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-taifoon
**Tested:** n8n 2.45.5 with n8n-nodes-taifoon 2.1.0, 2026-11-15: imported from this file into a fresh n8n and run against coord.taifoon.dev.

nodes.name: When a job completes
nodes.notes: Polls /v1/jobs with a resumable cursor. Emits once per (job, status), so a completion is never swallowed by an earlier "open".

nodes.name: Check it against the chain
nodes.notes: Never forward a completion on the strength of a status field. Returns REAL, FABRICATED or UNVERIFIED.

assignments.name: seller
assignments.value: ={{ $('When a job completes').item.json.seller.address || $('When a job completes').item.json.seller.agentId }}

nodes.name: Report
nodes.notes: What to forward: the job, its ending, and safeToAct — true only when the chain corroborated the completion. Never forward a completion on the strength of a status field alone.
